## [2.0.10](https://github.com/nobianh78/tada-patches/compare/v2.0.9...v2.0.10) (2026-10-22)

### ✨ New Features

* **Instagram:** Integrated full TADa Settings, Ghost mode (Anonymous story & live view, hide seen DM receipts, hide typing status), Media Downloader (Reels, Stories, Videos, Voice messages, Profile pictures), Ad blocking, and Reels controls.
